prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the chellow, a small flying bird-like creature seen at rest on the ground. Squat and round feathered body, like a plump ball of plumage, standing on exactly two thin legs, with a short tail tuft. The head is entirely featherless: bare wrinkled skin from crown to neck. There is no beak; in place of a mouth is a lipless flap of skin that vibrates to whistle. In the rear view, seen from behind, the folded wings, back and tail tuft show, and the bare head is turned away with the throat-fan hidden. In the front view, eyes toward the viewer, the bare face, flap mouth and full throat-fan show. In the side view the near folded wing and one leg show in profile. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour, clean dark outline. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
